name: Cast Your Cares
overview: Scripture calls believers to cast their burdens upon the Lord, trusting that He will sustain and uphold them with His righteous hand, as seen in Psalms 55:22 and Isaiah 41:10. God invites those who are weary and heavy laden to come to Him for rest and peace that surpasses worldly understanding, demonstrated in Matthew 11:28 and John 14:27. Though tribulation is inevitable in this world, Christ assures us of His victory and encourages us to be of good cheer, offering a peace that enables us to pour out our hearts to Him at all times, as reflected in Psalms 62:8 and John 16:33.
